title: Split mesh pipelines: external-only vs external+shell to eliminate VUID 08114
purpose: Avoid static use of binding 4 when shell TLAS is not ready by compiling two fragment shader variants and two pipelines.

steps.detail: Add a compile-time define (e.g., USE_SHELL_TLAS) in shaders/particle_mesh.frag to guard binding 4 and hasSelfShadowRT.
Create two pipelines: pipeline_ext (no binding 4; USE_SHELL_TLAS=0) and pipeline_ext_shell (binding 4 present; USE_SHELL_TLAS=1).

At render time, pick pipeline_ext when shell TLAS is NULL or not ready; pick pipeline_ext_shell when ready. Ensure descriptor pushes match the selected pipeline's layout (no write to binding 4 for pipeline_ext).

acceptance: No VUID-08114 when shell TLAS is NULL
Descriptor push sizes match selected pipeline layout
Visible rendering continues in mesh mode before shells are ready
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('statically used descriptors and pipeline layouts')
